Enquiries by D.S.I. Chu Chi Huang, C.D.S. 167,
C.D.C. 328 and the undersigned.
The complainant is employed as a clerk at
the Shanghai Stock Exchange and resides at house
No. 5, Lane 254 Hart Road.
At about 8.50a.m. 26/8/40 the complainant's
sister Hong Lien Chun ( ) was standing in
the lane outside of the above address, holding in
her arms the complainant's 11 months old son Hong
Kwei Sung ( ). Suddenly the 3rd. and 4th.
described men, approached the said female, the
3rd. described man produced a pistol and pointed
it at the female, ordering her to keep quiet.
The 4th. man then snatched the child from the
female's arm; and they both ran out of the lane
turning North into Hart Road. The female raised
an alarm whereupon the complainant together with
his servants ran out and on learning of the kidnap-
ping gave chase shouting for help. At that time
a Reserve Unit Search Party consisting of R.U.C.
11 Volsky and C.P.C's 2630, 2640 and 3008 was
operating at the corner of Hart and Avenue Roads.
The culprits heard the pursuit and on seeing
the Police Party in the direction of their escape
became alarmed and pushed the child into the arms
of an unknown pedestrian, after which they
separated and mingled with the crowd.
However, the R.U. Search Party, discerned the
accused (1st. described) running away from the
scene and arrested him.
The complainant was informed of the child's

由特别调查员朱志煌、刑事侦缉处167号、
刑事侦缉科328号及下述人员查询。
报案人在上海股票交易所任职员，居住于
赫德路254弄5号。
1940年8月26日上午8时50分左右，报案人的
姐姐 Hong Lien Chun ( ) 站在
上述地址外的弄堂里，怀里抱着报案人11个月大的
儿子 Hong Kwei Sung ( )。突然，第3名和第4名
描述的男子走近该女子，第3名描述的男子
掏出手枪指着该女子，命令她保持安静。
随后第4名男子从该女子怀中抢走孩子；两人
跑出弄堂，向北转入赫德路。该女子大声呼救，
报案人随即与其仆人跑出来，得知绑架情况后
一边追赶一边呼喊求助。当时，一支由后备队
警员11号 Volsky 及中央巡捕房警员2630、2640
和3008组成的后备队搜查组正在赫德路与爱文义路
拐角处执勤。
罪犯听到追捕声，并看到警方在其逃跑方向出现，
感到惊慌，将孩子塞给一名不知名的行人，随后
分散并混入人群中。
然而，后备队搜查组察觉被告（第1名描述者）
正从现场逃离，并将其逮捕。
报案人获知孩子的

fate, found the pedestrian and before arrival of the
Police took the child back home.
The accused in the meantime was brought to the
station by the R.U. Search Party which was accompanied
by the complainant's sister Hong Lien Chun.
The accused questioned by detectives admitted the
offence but made contradictory statements. However,
the following story, could be derived from his state-
ments: the offence was instigated by one Tung Yih
Ching ( ) (2nd. described) who, according to
the accused occupies a prominent post in a Japanese
sponsored political organisation situated at No. 62
Kong Ka Jae. The accused referred to this organisation
as "Tai Poo" ( 隊部 ), but this address is not known
to the detectives of this station. Tung Yih Ching,
for whom the accused has been making clothing in the
past, four days ago called the accused to the Sui Tai
Sing ( ) lodging house, 51 Kong Ka Jae, off
Connaught Road where in the room No. 11, the accused
was offered to participate in a kidnapping for ransom
of a child. The accused claimed that he agreed to
take custody of the child after the kidnapping and
keep him in the said lodging house. For the last
four days they daily met in the same lodging house
discussing details and Tung Yih Ching invited the 3rd.

1/3.

下落，找到那名行人，并在警察到达前
将孩子带回家中。
与此同时，被告由后备队搜查组带回警局，
报案人的姐姐 Hong Lien Chun 随行。
经侦探讯问，被告承认罪行，但供词前后矛盾。
不过，从其供词中可以得出以下情节：犯罪由
Tung Yih Ching ( )（第2名描述者）唆使，据被告称，
此人在位于康家宅62号的一个日本赞助的政治组织中
担任要职。被告称该组织为“Tai Poo” ( 隊部 )，
但本局侦探不知晓此地址。Tung Yih Ching 过去曾让
被告为其制作衣物，四天前将被告叫至康家宅51号
（康纳路旁）的 Sui Tai Sing ( ) 旅馆，在11号房间，
被告被邀请参与一起儿童绑架勒索案。被告声称他同意
在绑架后负责看管孩子，并将孩子藏匿在上述旅馆。
在过去四天里，他们每天在该旅馆会面商讨细节，
Tung Yih Ching 邀请了第3名

1/4.

and 4th. described man, who the accused claimed were
not known to him. At 6a.m. 26/8/40 they met at the
lodging house, and Tang Yih Ching brought a pistol,
which he gave to the 3rd. described man. At 6.30a.m.
even date they proceeded on foot to the vicinity of
the complainant's house, the accused received from
Tang Yih Ching the sum of $50.00 to cover expenses
for the keeping of the child. ($54.00 was found in
possession of the accused at the time of his arrest).
The accused was to wait on the road, receive the child
after the kidnapping and transport him in a ricksha to
the lodging house.

Tang Yih Ching watched the lane and at about
8.50a.m. pointed the child to the 3rd. and 4th. describ-
ed men, who then entered the lane and carried out the
offence.

Before he received the child, the accused heard
the alarm, which frightened him, therefore he ran
North along Hart Road, turning West into Avenue Road,
where he was arrested by the R.U. Search Party.

The Japanese Gendarmerie, 94 Jessfield Road were
requested to assist in raiding the said lodging house,
which they agreed to do themselves without being accom-
panied by any members of the S.M.P.

The raid was carried out by the Gendarmerie

1908/40.

1/4.

和第4名描述的男子，被告声称并不认识这些人。
1940年8月26日上午6时，他们在旅馆会面，
Tang Yih Ching 带来一支手枪，交给了第3名描述的男子。
同日早上6时30分，他们步行前往报案人住所附近，
被告从 Tang Yih Ching 处收到50.00元，用于支付
看管孩子的费用。（被告被捕时身上搜出54.00元）。
被告的任务是在路上等候，绑架发生后接收孩子，
并用黄包车将孩子运回旅馆。

Tang Yih Ching 监视弄堂，大约在上午8时50分，
向第3名和第4名描述的男子指示孩子所在，随后
这两人进入弄堂实施了犯罪。

在接收孩子之前，被告听到了警报声，这使他
受到惊吓，因此他沿赫德路向北奔跑，向西转入
爱文义路，在那里被后备队搜查组逮捕。

已请求极司菲尔路94号的日本宪兵队协助突袭
上述旅馆，他们同意自行行动，无需上海公共租界
工部局警务处任何成员陪同。

此次突袭由宪兵队执行
